grid.layout_notes: Official sheet layout code 23331 = reel heights 2-3-3-3-1. Last reel is 1 high base but xSplit Wild counts as 2 symbols high, yielding 108 ways (2×3×3×3×2).

win_system.notes: 108 ways from 2-3-3-3-1 layout with dual-high xSplit on reel 5. Wild multipliers from xNudge/xSplit apply to line/ways wins.

other.name: xNudge Wild
other.how_it_works: Stacked Wild always nudges until fully visible; each nudge step increases the Wild multiplier.

other.name: xSplit Wild
other.how_it_works: Appears only on the last reel, counts as 2 symbols high, and splits symbols to the left in half.

other.name: xRIP
other.how_it_works: If total win for the spin is less than the base stake, payout is zeroed (no payout).

wilds.name: xNudge Wild
wilds.behavior: Stacked Wild nudges fully into view; each nudge increases Wild multiplier. Multipliers from multiple Wild types increase the bonus-mode win multiplier and remain for the entire bonus round.

wilds.name: xSplit Wild
wilds.behavior: Only on last reel; 2 symbols high; cuts symbols to the left in half (splits them).

scatters.name: Hang 'Em High Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3 Hang 'Em High Scatters trigger 8 Hang 'Em High Freespins.

scatters.name: Boothill Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3 Hang 'Em High Scatters plus a Boothill Scatter trigger 10 Boothill Freespins.

specials.name: Cowboy (Boothill)
specials.behavior: During Boothill Freespins only Cowboy symbols land on the last reel; matching symbols elsewhere transform to Wilds. Each spin a random Cowboy gets a 5x–999x multiplier.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on a 2-3-3-3-1 ways grid. xNudge Wilds nudge fully into view adding multiplier per step; xSplit Wild on reel 5 can split symbols leftward. After wins are evaluated, xRIP voids any total win below the base stake. Enhanced Bet (+10%) guarantees a Scatter. Optional Nolimit Bonus buy enters Hang 'Em High or Boothill free spins.

phases.what_happens: Reels stop on 2-3-3-3-1 layout. Stacked xNudge Wilds nudge until fully visible, increasing Wild multiplier each step. xSplit Wild may land on reel 5 (2 high) and split symbols to the left.
phases.state_changes: Wild multipliers applied to affected wins

phases.name: Evaluate ways wins
phases.what_happens: Award ways wins left-to-right across up to 108 ways, applying Wild multipliers.

phases.name: xRIP check
phases.what_happens: If total win < base stake, xRIP sets payout to zero.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: 3 Hang 'Em High Scatters → 8 Hang 'Em High Freespins. 3 Scatters + Boothill Scatter → 10 Boothill Freespins.
phases.state_changes: Enter chosen free-spin mode if triggered

## Enhanced Bet
By increasing the basic stake by 10%, you may chase the gallows with a guaranteed Scatter symbol. Harsh, but higher reward.

## xNudge Wilds
Make sure to hang on - a stacked Wild symbol will always nudge to be fully visible with each nudge increasing the Wild multiplier.

## xSplit Wilds
Take cover, xSplit Wild only appears on the last reel and counts as 2 symbols high. When landing it will cut symbols to the left in half.

## xRIP
The dead aren’t mourned here; xRIP is triggered by any spin if the total win is less than the base stake, then there is no payout...
